# Watch That Pod

> Searchable streaming guide for The Rewatchables podcast — mapping every episode to the featured movie, cast, directors, and current US streaming, rental, and free viewing options.

## Key Resources
- [Watch That Pod Catalog](https://watchthatpod.com/): Interactive searchable table of The Rewatchables episodes and current streaming availability.
- [Full Episode & Streaming Catalog](https://watchthatpod.com/llms-full.txt): Complete Markdown directory of all indexed episodes, movies, directors, top cast, streaming services, and podcast audio links (updated daily).
- [Agentic Resource Discovery Manifest](https://watchthatpod.com/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable JSON manifest of resources available for AI agents.
- [XML Sitemap](https://watchthatpod.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL index with last-modified timestamp.

## Search & Filter URLs
- [Search by title, director, actor, or service](https://watchthatpod.com/?search={query})
- [Filter by streaming service](https://watchthatpod.com/?service={service})
- [Filter by director](https://watchthatpod.com/?director={director})
- [Filter by actor](https://watchthatpod.com/?actor={actor})
